simple.meaning: צָעַק (tsâʻaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to shriek ; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 55 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 4:10. Its contexts include family, sacrifice, blood, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָעַק (H6817).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
